items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Well, it so happened that I had played with a couple of guys in New York. And one of the guys got arrested for having a gun.

ctx.x: This is February the 13th, 1981. I'm sitting here talking to Walter Thomas, my dear friend, and we are both alumni of Cab Calloway's band, and we're just talking about some Jazz history on the Missourians. Let's talk about the Missourians today. How did you join the band?

Well, it so happened that I had played with a couple of guys in New York. And one of the guys got arrested for having a gun. You know, that was the time when the Sullivan Laws first got started. If they caught you with a gun, you just automatically got six months. So this guy had six months. And the thing was, I was supposed to come with the band...
Who was the cat that left?
